newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union-Wellington pound Otago 60-34.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Wellington pound Otago 60-34.

text.p: The Wellington Hurricanes scored more than 50 points for the second week in a row by beating the Otago Highlanders 60-34 in a Super 12 match on Saturday.
In a 14-try thriller, Wellington dominated and took advantage of numerous Otago errors to score a stream of runaway tries that helped them build up a 38-point lead.
A late burst by the visitors in the second half, when they narrowed the gap from 41-3 to 41-27 in a 15-minute spell of four tries, could only ease the pain of the inevitable loss.
